## Faster session search, agents on your phone & smoother chat switching ✨

We shipped two releases in quick succession: 1.4.254 yesterday and 1.4.255 today. See the [1.4.254 release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.254) for Git Graph, chat forks, on-device phone dictation, more resilient mobile work, and pairing and trust improvements.

A little less waiting, a little more flow. This update makes large session histories easier to search, brings your agents together on your phone, and smooths out the everyday work of switching accounts, models and workspaces.

- ⚡ **Find past work without slowing down:** Session History searches run off the app’s main thread, keep results visible while you type, and show your last list immediately after a restart while it refreshes. Search also works on SSH and remote-server hosts.
- 📱 **Your agents, together on your phone:** A new Agents tab lists agents across your connected desktops. Mark them read or clear them from the list, with activity status supplied by the desktop. Saved task lists and host labels appear sooner when you reopen the app.
- 💬 **Keep your chat moving:** Switching Codex accounts moves your open Codex chats to the account you choose. Forks preserve the chat’s history, pasted rich text keeps its links, and queued messages resume after a restart.
- 🎛️ **A clearer way to choose your setup:** Agent speed is now one button, model setup opens with your current choice highlighted, and searching for “codex” puts the Codex agent ahead of other agents’ Codex-named models—including when you press Enter.
- 🌳 **Do more from where you are:** Check out, cherry-pick or revert commits from Git Graph. Open the branch picker directly from the branch name under your chat composer, and choose your next action from a simpler empty split pane.

## Highlights

- **Session History & performance:** Large histories stay responsive while search runs in a worker. Workspace and Project filters query their own sessions, unchanged history rows avoid extra rendering, and search indexing and profile saves do less disk work.
- **Chat & agents:** Open Codex chats follow account switches, newly installed skills appear in Codex’s `$` menu before your first message, and Antigravity Chat shows installed skills. OpenCode 2 starts with the model you picked. Clearing a chat hides the old transcript immediately, and a failed model or effort change affects its message rather than the whole chat.
- **Phone & remote hosts:** The Agents tab brings activity across desktops into one place. Pages open sooner through prewarming, Review refreshes branch comparisons when Git changes, and the file-preview restore bar stays above the keyboard. A stalled LAN reconnect can fall back to Relay, and resumed VMs keep their device pairing when the host key is unchanged.
- **Workspaces & source control:** Git Graph gains checkout, cherry-pick and revert actions. You can preserve eligible child workspaces when deleting a parent, create a worktree for each repository from an empty folder workspace, and clone into a separate folder when a repository name is already taken. The sidebar divider resizes the sidebar reliably.
- **Browser, editor & terminal:** Remote browser tabs show site favicons, website links open in new tabs, and the CLI can list and reload installed browser extensions. PDFs fit the preview pane’s width. Terminal panes explain when another window is holding their size and offer a way to undo it.
- **Everyday polish:** Long Settings lists use searchable pickers, older chat messages show dates, and live agents stay visible in the unread filter. This release also fixes stale browser, Linear toolbar and usage-tooltip displays, plus the first Enter keypress after turning off Japanese IME.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.254...v1.4.255

## Git Graph, on-phone dictation & side questions in chat ✨

- 🌳 **See the whole repository:** A new Git Graph tab shows local and remote branches and tags, with each commit's details and changed files. Folder workspaces now get Source Control, with a card for each attached repo, and the branch name in Source Control switches or creates a branch in place.
- 💬 **Ask without derailing a chat:** In Chat UI, `/btw` asks a side question in a fork beside the chat while the original keeps running, and `/fork` branches from the latest response. Chats that open or push to a pull request show a short line when its CI passes or fails.
- 🎙️ **Dictate from anywhere:** Phones can turn speech into text on the device (iPhone on iOS 26 or later, and Android), with the computer as fallback. The computer, phones and web client can dictate at the same time, and on-device dictation runs in its own process, so a speech engine crash or hang no longer takes Orca down.
- 📱 **A phone that holds on to your work:** Chat sends queue while the desktop is unreachable and go out in order when it's back. Chat drafts, attachments, unsaved file edits and automation drafts survive the app being killed, and screens reopen from what the phone already has.
- ⌨️ **No more typing lag from Codex accounts:** Typing could lag across Orca while it linked Codex history between accounts. That work no longer blocks the app. Remote terminals also send a lone keystroke right away and read compressed output from remote hosts.
- 🔐 **Safer pairing and trust:** A pairing code stops working once the device that used it saves its own sign-in, desktop and CLI connections to remote servers use the newer encryption, and `orca serve` refuses connections from public internet addresses unless there's a reason to allow them. Orca asks once per new repo before trusting it for agents.
- 🎨 **Make Orca yours:** Import your own app icon, let theme plugins play a looping background video and ship their own fonts, and read Settings in titled cards. Claude Code can match your Orca terminal theme if you say yes.
- 🤖 **Better agent support:** Antigravity chats can run on the host's own agy, including Full access chats, and Muse shows its subscription quota in the status bar.

## Highlights

- **Chat:** `/btw` asks a side question in a fork and `/fork` forks from the latest response, with a spinner while the fork opens. Chats show CI results for the pull requests they opened or pushed to, and every waiting message, command and steer now sits in one ordered queue you can move, delete or send from.
- **Phone:** Send while the desktop is offline, keep drafts, attachments, file edits and automation drafts across app kills, and see the workspace list, session tabs and Review from memory while they refresh. Large folders load 500 entries at a time with Search all, Review prefetches the next and previous file, and a thin line under the header shows when cached data is refreshing.
- **Dictation:** Phones can transcribe on the device, and every device can dictate at once. On desktop the speech model loads before your first dictation (a new setting chooses when to unload it), dictation stops after a minute of silence and keeps what you said, dictated text gets a space before it, and text that can't be inserted is copied instead. The paired web client can dictate through the host.
- **Source control & editor:** Git Graph, Source Control for folder workspaces, and an in-place branch picker in the Source Control header. Wholly new and deleted files show one clean tint, Markdown keeps its syntax colors under plugin themes, HTML previews open in the editor's own tab group, and Copy as PNG says when an image is too large instead of claiming it copied.
- **Agents & accounts:** The Codex account-history typing lag is fixed. Antigravity chats can run on the host's agy when it's signed in, Antigravity sessions in AI Vault can reveal their artifacts folder, and Muse shows its quota and keeps panes working while background subagents run. The new-tab launch menu is simpler, the agent picker finds models from its submenus, and after a restart agents are told to finish the original task.
- **Remote hosts:** Remote terminals respond to keystrokes sooner, desktop chats on remote hosts stream only the new text, and polling slows down while the Orca window is visible but not focused. Managed SSH servers recover after a slow ProxyCommand login and in more dead-server cases, and automations for a managed SSH host go to its own Orca server.
- **Look & feel:** Import a custom app icon, use themed menus and clearer segmented controls, and use web fonts and looping background videos from plugins. Theme plugins can also style chat text and selection, which is now easier to read in dark mode. File and browser tabs fit their titles, so more fit before the tab strip scrolls.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Claude Code theme matching:** Orca can now match Claude Code's theme to your Orca terminal theme. It is off for everyone, including new profiles. The next time Claude Code runs, Orca asks once in a toast. Nothing in `~/.claude/settings.json` changes unless you accept, and you can change it later in Settings › Appearance › Terminal.
- **Search shortcut:** New Mac profiles open search with Cmd+K and have no default shortcut for clearing the terminal. New Windows and Linux profiles use Ctrl+K. Existing profiles keep their shortcuts, including custom and disabled ones.
- **Agent folder trust:** The first time you start an agent in a new repo, Orca asks whether to trust the repo or let each agent ask for itself. Repos you already use keep working as before, with no prompt. You can change the answer in the repo's settings.
- **Single-use pairing codes:** When an updated phone, browser or Orca pairs with an updated desktop, it switches to its own sign-in and the QR code or link it used stops working. Devices on older apps keep working, and Settings marks devices that still use the original pairing code or older encryption so you know which to update.
- **`orca serve` and public addresses:** `orca serve` accepts localhost, LAN and Tailscale connections by default and accepts public internet addresses only when there's a reason to. Existing setups keep connecting.
- **Speech model memory:** With voice on, Orca now loads the on-device speech model ahead of your first dictation. Use the new Unload Speech Model setting in Settings › Voice to free that memory sooner. Desktop dictation now also stops by itself after a minute of silence.
- **Windows terminal font weight:** Terminal text on Windows now uses the font's Regular weight by default instead of Medium, which Windows drew as SemiBold. macOS and Linux are unchanged.
- **New-tab launch menu:** Permissions and Arguments are no longer in the new-tab agent launch menu. They still come from Agent settings.
- **Onboarding:** The Antigravity Install button in onboarding is gone. Antigravity has the same Install instructions link as every other agent.

name: v0.9.25
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.25

Released on 2026-11-08.

Re-rendering a film with the same settings now gives the same result, because every render seeds its random values. A muted video's picture also no longer waits on its own audio track at a cut, and `check` replays an unchanged project's last pass.

## Features

- **CLI:** Check replays an unchanged project's last pass and takes --no-craft ([070b964d7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/070b964d7b8cd844a893f0abbe8e0b7f1ac6d879), [#7398](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7398)).

## Fixes

- **Core:** A muted video's picture no longer waits on its own audio track at a cut ([fa2e63515](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fa2e63515f3a4b80c7f0399c4f393a9a4c6f6d3f), [#7412](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7412)).
- **Producer:** Seed random values in every render so re-renders give the same film ([eb16510a1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/eb16510a10fbc30f230ae2b7d6e5a7ac50e31eeb), [#7410](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7410)).

## Internal

name: v2.3.0
body:
## v2.3.0 — 2026-11-08

### pm-execution

- Added **live-qa**: audience Q&A for an all-hands, AMA, customer webinar, launch, sprint review or talk. Anonymous questions, upvotes deciding the order, moderation before anything reaches the screen, questions opened before the session, and every unanswered question leaving with an owner and a date. It ends with a FAQ sent where the audience is and a short report. AskOne is the default tool (disclosed: it is made by this collection's author); Slido, Mentimeter and Pigeonhole Live work with the same method, and the skill says where the Q&A built into meeting tools falls short (in Zoom, upvotes need every question visible, so questions can't be screened first). With AskOne's MCP server connected, the agent creates the room, moderates, marks questions answered and drafts the FAQ.
- Added **live-polls**: polls, dot-voting, confidence votes, word clouds and quizzes in meetings, workshops and training. Votes are collected before the discussion with results hidden until the vote closes, the decision each result drives is stated before the vote, and the result is recorded beside the decision. AskOne by default, with Mentimeter, Slido, Poll Everywhere, Kahoot and the meeting tools' own polls named; with its MCP server the agent prepares the polls as drafts and launches each one when its topic comes up.
- **retro**, **pre-mortem**, **prioritization-frameworks** and **stakeholder-map** now say when to collect input anonymously and before the discussion, and point to the two new skills.

### pm-market-research

- Added **survey-design**, built on [The Ultimate Guide to Effective Customer Surveys](https://www.productcompass.pm/p/the-ultimate-guide-to-effective-surveys): whether you need a survey, a live poll or interviews; the decision and research questions before any question; who answers and the coverage gap; a pilot; twelve rules for writing questions; response-rate levers; non-response and low-quality answers; and CES, CSAT, NPS and Jobs-to-be-Done templates.

### pm-go-to-market

- **gtm-strategy** names a launch webinar or AMA with live audience Q&A among launch-day activities.

### Everything else

- **pm-ai-shipping moved to [phuryn/product-engineering](https://github.com/phuryn/product-engineering)**, which maintains the AI Shipping Kit in its `ai-shipping` plugin. Its three skills and five commands keep their names here and only say where each one went and how to install it, so an agent that loads one can tell you. Once product-engineering's plugin is installed, turn this one off.
- Added Cursor plugin manifests: a root `.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json` and a `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json` in every plugin, mirroring the Claude manifests. Claude manifests are unchanged.

name: v0.9.1
body:
# GPUI Kit v0.9.1

GPUI Kit 0.9.1 is a backward-compatible patch release. It adds a draggable GridLayout, right-pinned table columns, Markdown task checkboxes, link tooltips and motion transitions that outlive their element, along with a large batch of input, text, slider, accessibility and gpui-shell hardening fixes. The default backend moves to gpui-pre 0.3.12 and the optional GPUI Fast backend to 0.1.14.

## New APIs

- **GridLayout**: a grid whose items the user drags and resizes, also registered in the gpui-shell component catalog. ([#3770](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3770), [#3789](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3789))
- **Table**: `ColumnFixed::Right` pins columns to the right edge. ([#3833](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3833))
- **Text**: `on_task_toggle` makes Markdown task checkboxes clickable; block surfaces in `TextView`; pointer-following link tooltips. ([#3811](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3811), [#3830](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3830), [#3793](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3793))
- **Motion**: `TransitionState` for transitions that outlive their element. ([#3841](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3841))
- **Components**: `Button::selected_accent`, `Slider::track_focus`, `Dialog::accessibility_label`, `TimeField::separator`, `Toolbar::axis` for vertical toolbars, and a ratio-sized PieChart hole. ([#3775](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3775), [#3824](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3824), [#3826](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3826), [#3829](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3829), [#3821](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3821), [#3784](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3784))
- **WindowBorder**: the frame colour comes from the `window.border` theme token, and window corners can be rounded on request. ([#3849](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3849), [#3848](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3848))

## Editor and text input

- Keep the first typed character in the editor search panel, compose decoration styles deterministically, draw a placeholder for a folded line, and show the arrow over the gutter. ([#3772](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3772), [#3777](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3777), [#3791](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3791), [#3806](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3806))
- Tell the platform when the caret moves, publish layout at the end of prepaint, notify a moved input only while focused, and wait for the first layout before shaping an early value. ([#3827](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3827), [#3831](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3831), [#3828](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3828), [#3864](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3864))
- Keep the caret's visual line at soft wraps. ([#3842](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3842))

## Markdown and text rendering

- Supply editor foreground ranges through the render context and give span-less HTML paragraphs unique ids. ([#3754](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3754), [#3771](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3771))
- Tables: highlight the hovered body row, select aligned cell text where it is drawn, and size columns to their images. ([#3812](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3812), [#3813](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3813), [#3787](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3787))
- Limit selection highlights to selected glyphs, draw unsized inline images at their own size, and avoid quadratic paragraph highlight merging. ([#3799](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3799), [#3786](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3786), [#3846](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3846))

## Components

- **Table / DataTable**: name rows after their cells, centre default header names, Tab and Shift+Tab leave a focused DataTable, and a selected cell gets a border distinct from hover. ([#3773](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3773), [#3731](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3731), [#3800](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3800), [#3866](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3866))
- **Slider**: allow `min` above the default `max` while building, snap dragged values to steps from `min`, and step one thumb from assistive technology. ([#3823](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3823), [#3822](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3822), [#3840](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3840))
- **Menu**: size items and default max width in rems, and open a scrollable menu on its checked item. ([#3809](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3809), [#3814](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3814))
- **Settings**: follow locale changes in the search placeholder, clear search on Escape, show an empty state for unmatched searches. ([#3815](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3815), [#3816](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3816), [#3692](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3692))
- **Motion**: reverse an interrupted transition as CSS does, and keep value-transition timing under reduced motion. ([#3820](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3820), [#3839](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3839))
- **Scrolling**: stop smooth-scrolling wheels at the edge on macOS, let the parent scroll a swipe over a fitting horizontal area, and keep the overscroll stream alive through sideways packets. ([#3781](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3781), [#3779](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3779), [#3790](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3790))
- **List, Tab, WindowBorder**: accent rows use `accent_foreground`, icon-only tabs keep their width, the element id path stays stable across decoration changes. ([#3774](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3774), [#3792](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3792), [#3783](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3783))
- **Diff**: reject invalid hunk prefixes before slicing UTF-8. ([#3473](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3473))
- **WebView**: fix an X11 abort when a WebView is dropped on Linux. ([#3862](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3862))

## Accessibility

- Report a disabled `SliderThumb` to assistive technology. ([#3825](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3825))

## gpui-shell security and robustness

- Require a network grant for `WebViewState` pages, accept only `"*"` as the unrestricted `execute` grant, and check `Link.href` against the URL scheme rule. ([#3782](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3782), [#3802](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3802), [#3804](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3804))
- Refuse bundle values that would break generated scripts, bound script-supplied counts, nesting depth and self-nesting views, and leave proxy URLs out of the default `process.env`. ([#3803](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3803), [#3805](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3805), [#3808](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3808), [#3817](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3817), [#3810](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3810))
- Stop a Git dependency selector being read as a `git fetch` option, honor the manifest entry when bundling, expose group hover to scripts, and shrink `materialize_node` frames. ([#3778](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3778), [#3682](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3682), [#3796](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3796), [#3807](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3807))

## Dependencies

- Update `rustls-webpki` and `webpki-root-certs` for CVE-2026-111943. ([#3801](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3801))
- gpui-pre 0.3.12 and gpui-fast 0.1.14. Under GPUI Fast 0.1.14, views that were not notified reuse the previous frame instead of rebuilding. ([#3867](https://github.com/longbridge/gpui-kit/pull/3867))

name: v18.18.2
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Added

- Added `canReplayRemoteCompactionFrom()` to determine whether a model can replay provider-native compaction produced by another model.

### Fixed

- Fixed GenAI message-content capture configured in omp's own `.env` files so it continues to apply when those values are no longer exposed through the process environment.
- Fixed compaction preparation for remote OpenAI compaction that the active model cannot replay, ensuring the content is expanded and remains available for compaction.
- Fixed generic remote compaction requests to `/chat/completions` so gateway sessions retain the correct per-request model attribution.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Added

- Added edit execution context support for Cursor handlers, allowing integrations to identify frames that materialize native file edits and detect when server-side edits have settled.
- Exported Responses replay utilities so callers can determine which turns are sent as native payload items when estimating or trimming context.

### Fixed

- Fixed rotated credential pools reporting a stale sibling credential's authentication error instead of the exhausted credential's usage-limit status and reset time.
- Fixed OpenAI image edits with multiple input images failing because image parameters were duplicated.
- Fixed Cursor-provider reads of xd:// devices failing due to incorrect device URL handling.
- Fixed Anthropic sessions getting stuck after refused turns containing thinking or redacted-thinking blocks when followed by a steer, reminder, or new prompt.
- Fixed Codex Responses requests losing tool namespaces and developer-provided additional tools when replayed through the authentication gateway.
- Fixed Gemini malformed responses being treated as unhandled stop reasons and losing token usage; they are now handled as transient transport errors.
- Improved Cursor compatibility with TLS-intercepting proxies that block HTTP/2 by falling back to HTTP/1 for subsequent turns.

## @oh-my-pi/browser-relay

### Added

- The browser extension now requests Chrome’s downloads permission so relay tabs can report where downloads were saved to omp.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Fixed

- Fixed model catalog pricing and output-limit metadata for Mistral alias IDs, including the Mistral Vibe CLI default model, by applying the metadata of their aliased models.
- Updated xAI Grok 4.20 beta and multi-agent aliases to use the current Grok 4.20-0309 pricing, including the higher rates for prompts exceeding 200K tokens.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Breaking Changes

- `logoutCredential()` now accepts an `AgentSession` instead of a model registry and session ID. Hosts must install a scoped-model refresher with `AgentSession.setScopedModelsRefresher()`; `InteractiveMode` and `InteractiveModeContext` no longer accept `refreshScopedModelsAfterLogin`.
- `SessionStorage.hasAssistantTurn()` is replaced by the optional `scanLines(path, visit)`, which session listings use to recover both a missed assistant record and a first prompt past the 4 KB head; custom storages that implemented `hasAssistantTurn()` must implement `scanLines()` instead.

### Added

- The shell's `ls` builtin supports macOS/BSD `-O`: a long listing gains the file-flags column (`hidden`, `compressed`, `uchg`, `restricted`, …) instead of rejecting the option, so `ls -lO` works and flags are visible again.
- The shell ships `sd` as a builtin, so `sd FIND REPLACE [FILES]…` find-and-replace (regex or `-F` literal, in place or `-p` preview) works without the binary installed.
- Added `omp gc --strip` (or `gc.strip`), which removes provider replay data (thinking signatures, encrypted reasoning, cached native responses, request controls) from sessions idle for `gc.stripAfterDays` (default 30, `--strip-after-days`), including subagent and archived transcripts; stripped sessions still resume on any model.

### Changed

- The `sloppy` edit tool (`*** Find`/`*** Replace`) now rejects only the operations that fail to match and applies the rest, including across files; the result lists each rejected operation against the file as written, and the call fails only when no file changes. Payloads that do not parse still apply nothing.
- A `bash` call that overlaps another one (parallel calls, or a call while one runs in the background) now runs in a copy of the session shell, so it sees the session's variables, functions, options, and working directory from before the other command; what it sets still does not persist.
- The `.`/`c` continue shortcut now interrupts a running turn and continues it, in the main session and in focused subagent views, instead of failing with "Agent is already processing" or doing nothing.
- Updated system prompts with the ⁂ section marker and improved task completion guidance, including proportional verification, efficient file reading, batching independent operations, and stopping after changes are verified.
- Added faster isolated-subagent startup for ovnfs-backed checkouts, while preserving the existing baseline behavior for repositories with nested repositories or submodules.
- Improved extension and plugin management: `/extensions` now lists and toggles extensions from configured extension packages and installed plugins, and marketplace sources resolve relative and bare-name paths consistently with Claude Code.
- Scoped model lists now refresh after logout, model-catalog refreshes, and RPC login or logout, so available models stay synchronized with authentication and provider changes.
- Added source actions to LSP `code_actions`, including actions such as Organize Imports, with application by title or index.
- Browser automation now supports downloads from relay tabs and broader `role/` selectors for implicit landmarks and structural roles.
- Improved skill and session workflows: skills created or installed during a session become immediately discoverable, and user-attributed custom messages that start a turn receive the appropriate prompt setup.
- Validated security findings now display validation status, timestamp, and summary information.
- Dual-mode language servers retain pushed diagnostics alongside pull diagnostics, preserving build and lint errors across edits.
- Improved session navigation and reliability when switches, forks, branches, context resets, or new sessions overlap; requests are processed in order without freezing or misrouting messages.
- Improved eval and interactive execution behavior, including preservation of JavaScript state and output across asynchronous failures, clearer startup and runtime errors, and better reporting when kernels or runtimes terminate.
- Parent-to-subagent messages now appear as IRC cards in live and Agent Hub transcripts.
- Paused agent turns can allow the machine to sleep at safe boundaries and restore sleep prevention when resumed.
- Improved JSON-mode shutdown handling so final tool events and buffered output are preserved.
- Improved task efficiency and responsiveness for isolated subagents, file search, browser guidance on Linux/X11, and long-running or cancellable operations.
- Updated the `tui.mouse` setting documentation to accurately describe wheel-scrolling behavior.
- `mnemopi.dbPath` values beginning with `~` now resolve relative to the home directory.
- Disabling the Codex provider now prevents its configuration from overriding omp settings, and providers can be disabled without applying their other settings.
- `omp gc` now shows a progress bar for each slow step (listing and scanning sessions, scanning transcripts for blob refs, archiving) on interactive terminals.
- `omp gc --strip` and `--compress` start work immediately instead of first reading every session's metadata, and `--strip` processes several sessions at once with a running tally of transcripts stripped.
- `omp gc` without `--apply` now says up front that it is a dry run.

### Fixed

- Fixed `omp --resume` showing `(no messages)` for sessions whose first prompt follows a large memory recall, image-only message, or `/skill:` reply ([#16495](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16495))
- In the shell visualization, a running command's inline script, heredoc, or `sh -c`/`ssh` script stays undimmed with the command instead of fading as inactive.
- The shell visualization highlights heredocs and inline scripts behind launchers (`uv run python -`, `timeout 60 python3 -c`, `env … bun -e`, `ssh host 'bash -s' <<EOF`, `ssh host <<EOF`, `docker run … bash -euc`), names a heredoc by its `#!` line or the file it writes (`cat > "$dir/lib.rs"`), and highlights Rust, Go, C-family and Swift heredocs.
- On Windows, commands run by the bash tool, including `nohup` background commands, get a console of their own, so programs that draw directly on the console (xperf and PowerShell progress bars, password prompts) no longer corrupt the TUI ([#18517](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18517) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC)).
- Reading Reddit URLs now works when Reddit blocks its API: posts, comment threads, subreddits, and user pages fall back to a Redlib mirror and then the Arctic Shift archive, and render full nested comment trees.
- Limited xAI `web_search` to two hosted-search turns per request to help prevent unexpected X search costs.
- Fixed extension event delivery so each extension receives events in emission order, even when another extension is slow to process an earlier event.
- `pi.sendUserMessage()` now rejects when a message is dropped before a turn begins, including the cost-cap reason when available.
- Prevented OpenTelemetry settings from omp-managed `.env` files from leaking into child processes or in-process extensions.
- Supervised-service waits now complete only after logs, metadata, and session-owner state have been published.
- Fixed Windows daemon metadata loss when another process temporarily reads `meta.json`.
- Improved image-generation errors to report why each model in a failed fallback chain was unsuccessful.
- Fixed model switching after remote compaction so the destination provider can recover the necessary conversation history instead of receiving only a placeholder summary.
- Remote MCP HTTP and SSE connections now honor `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` from the agent environment, including certificates loaded after startup.
- Preserved provider prompt-cache reuse across auto-learn captures, skill updates, and other session changes that do not require rebuilding the full system prompt.
- Closing `/btw` history during tool approval now correctly returns focus to the approval prompt.
- URL reads now handle bot-protection challenges more reliably, try alternate user agents, and report blocked or failed results instead of returning a protection page as content.
- Timed-out or cancelled JSON reads now stop their `jq` processing promptly.
- Fixed standalone binaries loading extensions that import top-level `@oh-my-pi/pi-utils` subpaths.
- HUD job status updates now continue to reflect elapsed time instead of freezing until matching output arrives.
- Generic remote compaction now supports `before_provider_request` payload hooks.
- Background completions no longer start hidden turns after an ACP prompt ends or incorrectly leave the session busy.
- Fixed shell behavior for exit status and `EXIT` traps in subshells to match Bash semantics.
- Preserved provider prompt-cache hits when resuming sessions after pruning, rewinding, branching, tree navigation, or other history changes.
- Cursor native edit operations now display accurate edit cards and diffs, including failed edits, instead of misleading separate read/write cards.
- `grep` and `glob` now respect timeout and cancellation when ovnfs status or daemon handshakes stall.
- Fixed `--mode json` shutdowns so tool completion events and the final JSON record are not lost or truncated.
- Commands beginning with `cd /` now execute from the filesystem root as intended.
- Edit auto-repair now accounts for retry costs and stops before exceeding the session cost cap.
- MCP prompt commands now correctly assign positional arguments that follow `key=value` arguments.
- `/shake thinking` now reports and preserves reasoning blocks that the provider continues to replay, avoiding inaccurate context-reduction claims.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

### Fixed

- Fixed recall returning episodic summaries for working memories that had been invalidated.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Added

- Added Zig syntax highlighting for fenced Zig code in Markdown.
- Added `Shell.fork()`, a new shell whose session starts from this one's variables, functions, aliases, options, and working directory as of its last command boundary, without waiting for a command in flight.

### Fixed

- Built-in jq filters now stop reliably when aborted or timed out, even before producing output.
- Fixed logical directory changes with cd and pwd in native Windows shell sessions, including drive and UNC paths.
- Fixed closed file descriptors passed to external commands on Unix so writes fail as expected; closed standard streams on Windows now use the null device.
- Fixed setValue() on Linux reporting success when Firefox or Thunderbird fields, including password fields, were not actually updated; failures now identify the affected field appropriately.

## @oh-my-pi/omp-stats

### Fixed

- Fixed the trace dashboard returning HTTP 431 for sessions with many subagents.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- Added a model catalog refresh callback that lets applications update the active model scope after catalogs are re-fetched.
- Preserved unfinished answers in ask dialogs and custom editors, allowing users to resume drafts when reopening them.

### Changed

- Simplified Bash previews for redirection to /dev/null by showing a single icon in the Nerd Font symbol preset.

### Fixed

- Fixed streaming and scrolling display issues in terminals without synchronized output, including duplicated rows and blank screens or status lines.
- Fixed Markdown rendering while streaming list items, preserving bold text and heading formatting.
- Fixed wrapping of long embedded Bash arguments so indentation and the gutter remain aligned.
- Fixed prompts and Enter presses entered while the application was starting so they submit normally instead of leaving Enter as a newline.
- Fixed restored transcripts so aliased tool calls use the same rendering as live tool calls.
- Fixed debugger tool cards with tabs and control characters in arguments so their displayed width remains accurate.
- Fixed LaTeX styling in nested content, including bold and italic resets, radical and optional-argument styling, color scoping, and inline math in headings.
- Fixed unnecessary repainting in the setup wizard while waiting for input in ANSI terminals.
- Fixed Windows ConPTY event handling so delayed terminal event data no longer appears in the composer.
- Fixed OSC 8 hyperlink support in Rex terminals so transcript URLs and file paths are command-clickable.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Added

- Added utilities for reading OpenTelemetry configuration from omp-managed `.env` files, including `$otelEnv` and `withOmpOtelEnv`.
- Added filesystem path utilities for checking paths through symlinked roots, including paths that do not yet exist, and for optionally propagating filesystem errors in directory checks.

### Fixed

- Fixed relaxed JSON parsing so `__proto__` is preserved as a regular own property rather than modifying the parsed object's prototype.
- Fixed SIGHUP handling so stopped terminal sessions display recovery hints, including the `--resume` command.

name: Reasonix Studio v2.58.1
body:
本版是修复版：修好 2.58.0 里设置页版面错位、会话行置顶按钮常驻、模型菜单标签折行、思考「展开」被限高等问题，修复 Windows 启动闪控制台窗口、命令行 `mcp --help` 误执行和 Linux 终端选择。

## 变更

- 桌面壳的 Electron 升到 45.2.3（Chromium 156，含上游的安全与稳定性修复）。关联 #15027。

## 修复

- 修复 Linux 上「在终端中打开」不管你把哪个终端设成默认，总是按固定顺序挑一个（比如装了 konsole 就先用它，而不是你的 kitty）。现在如果装了 `xdg-terminal-exec`（桌面规范里读取默认终端的启动器），就由它按你机器声明的默认终端打开；没装的话仍按原来的顺序（#15031）。
- 修复命令行里 `reasonix mcp import --help`（以及 `mcp remove --help` 等其他子命令）不会显示用法，反而把 `--help` 当成参数真的去执行：`import` 会直接改写 MCP 配置。现在所有 `reasonix mcp` 子命令的 `--help` / `-h` 都只打印用法并退出，什么都不改；`mcp import` 带多余参数时会报错而不是照常导入（#15022）。
- 修复 2.58.0 里，开着「会话行快捷按钮」时，侧栏每一行会话都一直显示一个置顶图标（不管有没有置顶）：现在这个按钮只在鼠标移上去或键盘聚焦时才出现；已置顶的会话在没悬停时会一直显示一个小图钉，方便一眼看出（#15012）。
- 修复输入框右下角的模型选单里，模型名字较长时，右边的「读图」标签被挤成两行竖着排的问题；现在标签始终在一行里完整显示（#15012）。
- 修复 2.58.0 里设置的「模型」「连接」等单栏页面：顶部「本页包含」目录和下面的标题、卡片没有对齐，卡片左边多出一大块空白（现在三者对齐到同一条左边线）（#15008）。
- 修复从「操作与性能」点开「导航入口」这类二级页时，顶部多出几条空白的横条；现在二级页里只显示它自己（#15009）。
- 修复设置里「思考过程」选成「展开」后，模型思考时仍然只显示最新六行、要等整段思考结束才一下子全部显示的问题：选「展开」时，运行中的思考块现在随内容一直完整展开；「进行中展开」仍是最新六行的滚动窗口（#15013）。
- 修复 Windows 上每次启动 Reasonix Studio 都会先闪一下黑色控制台窗口的问题：启动时用来确认"是不是同一个 Studio"的内核探测，以及启动内核本身，现在都隐藏控制台窗口（#15016）。

---

<!-- lang:en -->

## Changed

- The desktop shell moves to Electron 45.2.3 (Chromium 156, with upstream security and stability fixes). Refs #15027.

## Fixed

- On Linux, "Open in terminal" picked a terminal by a fixed order rather than the one the machine declares as its default (konsole before kitty, for example). When `xdg-terminal-exec` is installed, it now starts the machine's default terminal; without it the old order still applies (#15031).
- `reasonix mcp import --help` (and `--help` on the other `mcp` subcommands) did not print usage and ran the command with `--help` as an argument, so `import` rewrote the MCP configuration. Every `reasonix mcp` subcommand now prints usage for `--help` / `-h` and changes nothing, and `mcp import` refuses extra arguments instead of importing (#15022).
- With "Quick buttons on session rows" turned on, every session row in the sidebar showed a pin icon all the time, pinned or not (2.58.0). The button now appears only when the pointer is over the row or it has keyboard focus, and a pinned session keeps a small pin on the row while nothing is hovered (#15012).
- In the model menu next to the message box, the "reads images" tag was squeezed into two stacked characters beside a long model name; it now stays whole on one line (#15012).
- In Settings, single-column pages such as Model and Connection no longer draw the "On this page" index out of line with the title and cards, which left a wide empty strip beside the cards in 2.58.0; all three now share one left edge (#15008).
- Opening a sub-page such as Navigation entries from Operation and performance no longer leaves a few empty bars above it; the sub-page shows only itself (#15009).
- With Thinking set to "Open", a thought still showed only its latest six lines while the model was thinking and then jumped to the full text when it finished. In "Open" the running thought now grows with its text; "Open while running" keeps the six-line rolling window (#15013).
- On Windows, launching Reasonix Studio no longer flashes a console window first: the kernel probe that tells whether this is the same Studio, and the kernel launch itself, now run with their console hidden (#15016).

## What's Changed
* chore(deps-dev): bump electron from 45.1.0 to 45.2.3 in /desktop/electron in the npm group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/15027
* chore(deps): bump the npm group in /desktop/frontend-next with 11 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/15029
* chore(deps): bump the actions group with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/15028
* chore(deps): bump the go group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/15025


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.58.0...studio-v2.58.1


---

**macOS** 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。**Windows** 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。**Linux** Debian 系从 `.deb` 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 `.rpm` 安装（`sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm`）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。也提供 `.AppImage`（只提供下载，不会自更新；需要 FUSE 2，或用 `--appimage-extract-and-run` 启动）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 `.deb` 走自己的包（`.rpm` 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

name: v0.9.33
body:
Drop-in upgrade on iii 0.25.1. Docker installs that set only an LLM key: add `AGENTMEMORY_LLM_PROVIDER` (see Changed).

## Added
- Stores above 64 MiB keep working: whole-scope reads page, transport cap raised to 64 MiB (#1636, #1634)
- Session list filters `startedAfter`, `startedBefore`, `endedAfter`, `endedBefore` (#1527)
- `AGENTMEMORY_SUMMARY_TIMEOUT_MS` for large sessions on slow or local LLMs (#1689)
- `memory_diagnose` / `memory_heal` find and remove orphaned facets (#1698)

## Fixed
- Search no longer caps saved memories at three per query (#1696); evicted memories leave the indexes (#1601)
- Boot detects gaps in a partially embedded vector index (#1687); CLIP text-to-image search uses the text tower (#1250)
- PreToolUse context reaches the model (#1693); enrichment scoped to the current project (#1220); SessionEnd has time to finish (#1692)
- Redaction runs before truncation and covers compound secret key names (#1695, #1701)
- Placeholder keys like `sk-...` count as unset (#1588); circuit breaker resets on success and ignores content-filter rejections (#1350, #1277)
- MCP shim waits 190 s, so long consolidate and reflect calls finish (#1691)
- Consolidation keeps provenance across retries (#1545, #1690); scoped reflection stays in its project (#1544)
- `connect` honors `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` (#1703); Cursor subagent stop fields mapped (#1684)
- Fresh installs retry the iii engine download on timeouts, 408, 429 and 5xx (#1719)
- `health` CPU is machine-relative (#1286); `demo` stops its workers on Windows (#1688); Compose values keep newlines (#1708)

## Changed
- Pins iii 0.25.1 with state 0.22.22 and http 0.22.8; first start installs them (#1634, #1694)
- Unpaged `GET /memories` and `/relations` over the transport limit return 413 with a paging hint; use `?limit=N` (#1636)
- Root and Coolify Compose files forward `AGENTMEMORY_LLM_PROVIDER` (#1700)

## Tested
Packed release gate on Linux x64 and arm64, macOS arm64 and Intel, Windows x64 and arm64 (#1716).

## Contributors
Thanks @yxtay, @DimitriChrysafis, @mvanhorn, @anhtahaylove, @devon3000, @mothieras, @dmazhukov, @redeye1011, @dKaulig, @DanielCarmingham, @Mike-Animal-Counseling and @zhichao-poper.
