name: v5.1.65
body:
**A message an agent sends to a session on another device now says who sent it.** It used to arrive there as plain text, indistinguishable from that session's own user. It now carries the same sender line and authority notice as a message between sessions on one device (the sending session, its workspace and project, and the device it came from), and a leading `/` in it no longer runs a command or expands a prompt template on the receiving side. `omo remote send` from a terminal is unchanged. ([#12858](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12858), part of [#12852](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12852))

**Memory retention no longer evaluates its completion-record guard twice per record.** The completion sweep now reads the guard once and keeps or removes the record on that single answer, and the retention tests check their own preconditions instead of asserting them away. No change to what retention keeps or removes. ([#12783](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12783), follow-up to [#12532](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12532))

**The standalone `omo` binary's `omo doctor` reports memory runtime size again, like the npm install.** Each memory identity's runtime size against its cap and the total across identities are printed by both distributions, so binary/npm doctor parity holds ([#12785](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12785)). ([#12783](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12783))

**Old binary runtimes are pruned safely when two `omo` launches start at once.** A launch no longer deletes a runtime another launch is still pruning, and a runtime that launch already removed is not reported as a failure. `omo --version`, `--help` and `omo update` never prune. ([#12770](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12770), follow-up to [#12627](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12627))

**A task child whose engine cannot hold its designated model chain is no longer started.** Before, when a process child's engine could not take its chain (an older engine, a refused `set_retry_fallback`, or no answer in time) or a task host did not advertise `retry_fallback_profile`, the child was still prompted and ran on the engine's own fallback settings, which can reach models outside its chain. The start now fails before the first prompt and names every designated model and the reason, and such a host is refused as incompatible, naming the same models. ([#12759](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12759)) ([#12761](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12761))

**A command on a closed session on another device now reports the same error as on this device.** It answered `session_not_found` remotely and `unknown_session` locally; both now answer `unknown_session`. ([#12755](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12755)) ([#12756](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12756))

**omo hands its device keys to the device service from memory, with no credential store read for relay.** A fresh sign-in (`omo login`, `omo account adopt`) deletes the signed-out marker and then hands its in-memory keys and account to a running device service. The memory sync session re-adopts from the credential it already holds when the service reports no adopted device. Every sign-out path (logout, forget, a session the service ended) tells the service to forget the device. The start-up bootstrap no longer reads the stored credential. `device.adopt` carries `account` only to a device service at 0.1.3 or newer, and the pinned device service is raised to 0.1.3 (design D PR 4). ([#12735](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12735))

**`omo remote` can open, send, switch model, interrupt and close sessions on your other devices.** `omo remote open <device> [--project P] [--model M]` starts a session there and prints `<device>/<session>`; `omo remote send <device>/<session> <text>` prints the answer as it streams in and returns when the turn settles (`--steer` steers the running turn, `--follow-up` queues behind it, `--no-wait` returns once the session took the message); `model`, `interrupt` and `close` do what they say. Each verb is the same remote op the agent's thread tools use, and `--json` prints its typed result. A steer to a session on another device now reaches it when that device's engine reports its running turn, instead of always being refused. ([#12709](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12709), part of [#12320](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12320))

Creating or forking a thread on another device no longer waits for a separate `session.locate` round trip: the create asks the relay for the new session's id on the `open_session` reply and uses it. A relay daemon without that answer (an older host, or an older service on this device) is handled as before, with `session.locate`. ([#12686](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12686))

**`omo update` on the standalone binary now replaces the installed `omo`.** It used to print a replace command for the copy under `~/.omo/binary-runtime/<version>/`, which the next launch put back, so the update never took. A launch also removes old runtime versions there, keeping the previous one for a rollback and any version still running. ([#12627](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12627), fixes [#12626](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12626))

**Each memory identity's runtime directory is capped at 2 GiB, and `omo doctor` and `/doctor` show how much it holds.** After retention, the 12-hour memory maintenance pass evicts oldest-first until the identity fits `memory.runtime.max_bytes` (default 2 GiB, `0` for unbounded, per-agent overridable under `memory.agents.<id>.runtime`). It removes folded reflection runs first, then the transcripts of fully reflected sessions, idle sidecars, and finally old failed runs beyond the newest ten. Journals that were never or only partly reflected are kept by default; `memory.runtime.discard_unreflected_journals: true` lets the cap evict them too, and only while reflection is succeeding on the identity. Live sessions, in-flight runs and the run-id high water are never touched. `omo doctor` prints each identity's runtime size and the total, and warns when an identity reaches 80 % of its cap. `/doctor` adds a `runtime-size` check with the largest stores and what retention would still free. ([#12538](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12538))

**Memory no longer grows without bound on disk.** The background memory maintenance pass now removes finished reflection runs, fully reflected transcripts, recall sidecars and legacy stores past configurable windows (`memory.runtime.retention_days` 7, `completions_days` 30), in time-boxed slices that resume where they stopped. Transcript input reflection never folded into memory is kept unless you turn on `discard_unreflected_journals` (then removed after `abandoned_journal_days`, 14, only while reflection works for that agent). Nothing a live session owns, no locked or unfinished work and no run id reflection still needs is touched. ([#12532](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12532))

A reflection lock left behind by a run whose processes died (launcher killed before the run started, supervisor and child gone with no outcome, an unreadable run ledger, or a torn `active.lock`) is now released at session start, on the next turn, and by the new `omo doctor --fix` (`--dry-run` to preview, `/doctor --fix` in a session), instead of keeping every later reflection queued; `omo doctor --fix` also reclaims runtime locks whose owner is gone. ([#12517](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12517))

### Fixed

- Senpi: omo now names any senpi feature it relies on that the running senpi lacks in one startup warning, and opening a monitor on another device's session on a senpi without remote wake fails with `remote_wake_unavailable` instead of starting a watch that never wakes. A contract test checks every such feature against the pinned senpi. ([#12862](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12862), fixes [#12861](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12861))
- The browser skill now depends on the published `omowright` package (`^0.3.0`, the first release that ships a built `dist/` that loads under Node as well as Bun) instead of a git commit. Its runtime stager and loader accept omowright's TypeScript sources, the older JavaScript sources, or a compiled `dist/`, in that order, so a future layout change cannot silently break the staged browser runtime (#12842, #12851, #12847). ([#12847](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12847))
- Memory facts extraction records facts again with senpi 2026.11.6-3: the facts child (also used by onboarding's understand step) keeps the approval mode its own settings give it and may run only its own record tools without asking, instead of being refused as a child whose parent is gone. ([#12839](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12839))
- Concurrent memory account resolves on a desktop host share one open, so the app sees one `descriptor` request instead of one per caller; a failed open is retried by the next resolve (carried from #12717, which this PR supersedes). ([#12839](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12839))
- Thread tools: an agent can now reach a session on another device of the same account by its name. A name that matches the title of one live session on another device sends there, and a name shared across devices (or with a thread on this device) is refused as ambiguous with every candidate and its device listed, never picked silently. Claiming or renaming a thread alias on a signed-in CLI device now reaches the account's alias registry instead of always answering that the registry cannot be reached; an alias claimed on one device now reaches that thread from every other device instead of reporting its device offline, and a registry outage never changes how a plain name resolves. `omo thread read` resolves aliases and other devices' threads the way the agent's `thread_read` does. ([#12837](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12837), fixes [#12833](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12833))
- Release: the service-auth release step now refuses a bundle that carries more than one release key set, so it always checks the set the bundle ships. ([#12812](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12812), fixes [#12617](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12617))
- Runtime fallback: when a session times out and no fallback model can be prepared, the user is now warned even if nothing was awaiting a fallback, the warning names the real reason ("no available fallback models" while attempts remain, instead of "max fallback attempts reached"), and a compaction that outlives its watchdog budget returns control as a real cancellation without staying marked as recovering. ([#12790](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12790), fixes [#12762](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12762))
- Standalone binary on Windows: running the provisioned runtime copy directly (`~/.omo/binary-runtime/<version>/omo.exe`) no longer hands off to itself and reports itself as the installed launcher when the home path is spelled with an 8.3 short name or different letter case. ([#12772](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12772), fixes [#12769](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12769))
- While service accounts are closed, the compiled `omo` binary recognises the device-code `omo login` with the same option parse as the command itself, so `omo login -- --device` and similar argv get the immediate refusal instead of being handed on to the command. ([#12723](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12723), fixes [#12646](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12646))
- The browser skill's doctor no longer calls a browser ready when its only BrowserSkill extension is 0.4.0. That release left a "BrowserSkill" tab group in the user's browser after every task. The doctor now reports `outdated-extension` and tells the user to update the extension and delete the saved groups. ([#12663](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12663))
- `omo` no longer warns "Could not download the OmO device service. Check the connection and try again." on every interactive start while the device service release it pins has not been published. A 404 for that release is now its own `not_published` state: the start stays quiet, and `omo remote bootstrap` says remote devices are not available in this build yet. A connection failure, a server error or a half-published release still warns. ([#12659](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12659))
- When a dream or reflection run deletes, archives or moves a memory note, `[[path]]` and relative markdown links to it in other notes are now updated in the same run, after the completion check has decided which of the run's changes land. A moved note's links follow it, and the moved note's own relative links keep pointing at their targets. A note the run archived, meaning its `ARCHIVE.md` entry names the file (its path, or its file name when no other note shares it), is linked as `[[ARCHIVE.md|<old path> (archived)]]`. Links to any other removed note, such as one the user asked to forget, become plain text. A note the completion check refuses, or one whose rewrite it would refuse (for example a note that already holds secret-like text), or one that is not valid UTF-8, keeps its links as they were, so `/doctor` can still report those. A targeted `/dream --to <doc>` that removes its own target is no longer refused because of these link updates. Facts extraction also no longer writes into a month ledger path that was archived or deleted: that month's new facts go to `notes/facts/<month>-2.md` (then `-3`, ...), so an old link can never start pointing at unrelated new content. ([#12642](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12642)) ([#12645](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12645))
- Runtime fallback keeps compaction retries separate from the primary model chain and preserves substantive retry prompts. Compaction watchdogs defer within a bounded budget, exhausted native retry signals do not trigger an abort, and stuck-session watchdogs still return control when no replacement can be dispatched. Thanks @mradwankhalil. ([#11907](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11907), fixes [#9786](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9786))
- Background tasks let runtime fallback decide who recovers a session error before starting a replacement or finalizing the task. Exhausted and refused retries release recovery ownership, model-less retry errors can finish the task, and a slow decision never starts a competing replacement. ([#9683](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9683), [#11907](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11907))
- Runtime fallback keeps its place in the fallback chain when its own abort echoes back as a stop or idle event, and no longer mistakes its own retry for a manual model change. A failing fallback now moves on to the next model instead of going back to the model that just failed. ([#11901](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11901), fixes [#6751](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/6751))
- Runtime fallback: a session timeout whose fallback dispatch is rejected now uses up the attempt, stops at `max_fallback_attempts`, and ends with an abort the caller sees instead of re-arming the timer forever. ([#11898](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11898), fixes [#6637](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/6637))
- First-prompt refusal tests now await launch settlement when the bounded start report arrives first, preserving both untyped and non-credential refusal diagnostics without depending on subprocess startup speed (#11732). ([#11852](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11852))

### Changed

- Task children ask through the parent session instead of being refused: a child's permission prompt (and its other select, confirm, input and editor dialogs) is raised on the parent's UI, so Allow runs the child's call and Deny does not. A child the parent turn is waiting on asks on the connection that started that turn; a background child asks every attached client that may answer. Secret inputs and permanent grant selections are never forwarded. Children in their own process or on the task host open in the parent's approval mode and follow every later change of it, one change at a time and always ending on the latest; a child that could not follow is reported to the parent session. ([#12839](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12839))
- `omo remote open` and the thread tools' create and fork on another device name the approval mode the new session runs in: the creating session's own mode, or for `omo remote open` the new `--permission-preset` flag, else this device's own setting; a setting that cannot be read is a usage error rather than the loosest mode. ([#12839](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12839))
- The compiled engine no longer has the unused `installEngineCaTrust` startup routine. That routine set `NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA=1` but had no caller, and engine launches set up certificate trust in the launcher trust stage. A new test checks that an engine started without `NODE_USE_SYSTEM_CA` in its environment does not get it from the launcher. Validation of `OMO_EXTRA_CA_CERTIFICATES` is unchanged. ([#12628](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12628), part of #10762)

name: CC Switch v4.0.28
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.28

本版本主要应对 Codex 11 月 8 日的不兼容更新。

> ⚠️ **Codex 桌面版 26.1103、CLI 0.167 起，官方订阅和第三方供应商的会话彻底分开了。** 直连模式下在两者之间切换，以前只是两边的会话分开显示，现在另一边的会话直接变成只读：能查看，不能继续，继续时提示「模型提供商不匹配」。要来回切换并继续旧会话，有两个办法：
>
> 1. **改用路由或聚合模式**：本版本起，路由或聚合模式下切到第三方，会话和官方订阅留在同一组，来回切换都能继续。
> 2. **打开「统一 Codex 会话历史」**（「设置 → 应用配置 → Codex」）：官方和第三方的会话归到同一组，直连模式下也能来回切换。

此外，直连切换让会话变成只读时会提示数量；开启「统一 Codex 会话历史」并勾选迁入现有会话后，会持续把官方会话迁进来。官方额度用完、Codex 锁住发送键时，可以在路由或聚合设置里打开「暂停使用官方登录」，继续用第三方模型；官方额度保护改为默认开启。应用页的安装和升级会显示排队状态和实时进度。另外修复了 Codex 故障转移到别家时仍带着上一家的模型名、Kimi For Coding 上压缩失败、在 Kimi 或 DeepSeek 上续接工具调用后会话一直报 400 等问题。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.28-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.28-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### 适配新版 Codex 的会话分组

Codex 按供应商标识记录会话：官方订阅记在内置的 `openai` 下，CC Switch 写入的第三方供应商记在 `custom` 下。新版 Codex 只能继续与当前供应商同一组的会话，另一组只读（[#7974](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7974)）。本版本围绕这一点做了以下改动：

- **路由或聚合模式下切到第三方，会话不再分成两组**：本机登录了 ChatGPT、且没有开「统一 Codex 会话历史」时，路由到第三方也和官方一样写成内置的 `openai`，请求照常经本地路由发往第三方，所有会话都在 `openai` 这一组。第三方的 Key 由本地路由替换，ChatGPT 的账号 ID、组织等请求头会被去掉，第三方收不到你的账号信息。
  - 以下情况仍写成 `custom`：本机没有 ChatGPT 登录、开着统一会话历史、打开了「暂停使用官方登录」，或者供应商配置里写了请求重试、流重试、流空闲超时、远程压缩这些内置 `openai` 表达不了的设置。
  - 已经在用路由模式的不用操作，CC Switch 下次接上路由时会自动改写一次。直连模式不变。
- **直连切换后提示有多少会话只能查看**：没开统一会话历史时，直连模式下在官方订阅和第三方之间切换，切换成功的提示里会多一行，例如「之前在官方订阅下的 12 个会话现在只能查看」。从托盘切换不提示。
- **统一 Codex 会话历史**（「设置 → 应用配置 → Codex」）：开启后官方订阅也改用 `custom` 标识，两边的会话在同一组，新版 Codex 里都能继续。经常在官方和第三方之间切换时建议开启。
  - 「同时迁入现有官方会话历史」改为默认勾选。勾选后，之后每次启动 CC Switch 都会把又出现在官方组的会话迁进来，比如关掉再打开过这个开关，或者不经 CC Switch 用过 Codex。
  - 迁移和还原前都要备份 Codex 的会话数据库，以前 42 MB 的数据库要备份约 90 秒，现在不到 1 秒。
  - 后台迁移完成后会提示迁入了多少个会话，重启 Codex 后就能继续。

### 暂停使用官方登录（Codex）

官方 ChatGPT 额度用完后，Codex 会自己查额度，锁住模型选择和发送键，选了第三方模型也发不出去（[#7974](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7974)、[#7962](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7962)）。这一步在 Codex 客户端里，本地路由管不到；以前手动把 `requires_openai_auth` 改成 `false` 的办法，现在切换一次就会被覆盖。

现在 Codex 的「路由设置」和「聚合设置」（路由或聚合模式生效时，模式标签栏右端的齿轮按钮）最上面多了「暂停使用官方登录」开关：

- 打开后 Codex 不再使用官方登录，不会因为官方额度锁住发送键，聚合和路由里的第三方模型可以继续用。官方登录仍保存在本机，不会退出。
- 打开期间，官方模型发不出去，会提示改用第三方模型；Codex 里不显示账号和用量信息，第一次打开可能弹出新手问卷；侧栏「项目」里原来的会话暂时看不到，关掉开关后会回来；新会话记在 `custom` 组，切回官方后只能查看。
- 打开期间 Codex 页面顶部会一直有提示，官方额度恢复后点「恢复官方登录」即可。
- 打开和关闭后都要彻底退出并重新打开 Codex。只在路由和聚合模式下生效，直连不受影响。

### 应用页显示安装进度

应用页的安装、升级和卸载一次只跑一个，以前慢的时候每一行都在转圈，分不清是在下载、在排队还是卡住了（MiniMax Code 的安装包约 100 MB，网络慢时要十几分钟）。现在排队的那一行会写「排队中，等前一个应用完成」，正在跑的那一行显示已用时间和命令输出的最新一行。离开应用页再回来，进度还在。

---

## 变更

- **官方额度保护改为默认开启**：经本地路由的 Codex 官方请求，在五小时使用率达到 95% 或每周使用率达到 98% 时就会暂停，第三方模型照常可用，避免走到 Codex 锁住发送键那一步。升级后会自动打开一次；之后手动关掉，不会再被打开。阈值在「设置 → 应用配置 → Codex → 官方额度保护」里改。
- **不再写入 `disable_response_storage`**（[#7524](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7524)）：新版 Codex 删掉了这个设置，每次启动都会提示有一个无法识别的配置项。预设、模板、统一供应商和一键导入链接都不再写它，已有 `config.toml` 里的这一行在下次切换时清掉。
- **Antigravity 显示 Argon 每周额度**（[#8913](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8913)）：Pro 套餐的 Argon 每周额度以前不显示。现在卡片上把它并进 Gemini 那一行，下拉菜单和授权中心单独列出。
- **Windows 上第一次启动更快**：新建数据库时建表和写入内置模型价格各合成一次提交，第一次启动快了约 6 秒。

---

## 修复

- **Codex 故障转移到别家时，仍带着上一家的模型名，备用供应商报模型不存在**（[#7547](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7547)）。现在开着故障转移时，换到备用供应商前会先看它认不认请求里的模型（是它自己的模型，或在它的模型列表里），不认就换成它自己的模型；同一个模型的中转队列照原样发。图片生成、图片编辑和搜索请求不换模型。
- **Codex 经路由连 Kimi For Coding 时，压缩上下文总是失败（HTTP 400）**。Kimi 不接受压缩请求里的 `tool_choice: "none"`；现在第三方原生 Responses 上游拒绝压缩请求时，会去掉 `tool_choice` 再试一次。
- **Codex 在 Kimi 或 DeepSeek 的原生 Responses 上续接工具调用后，这个会话之后每一轮都报 400**。工具调用和它的结果之间夹了一条助手消息，Kimi 和 DeepSeek 都会拒绝整段历史；Kimi 还会拒绝空的助手消息。现在只对 Kimi（Moonshot）和 DeepSeek 的地址整理这类历史，其他请求原样发出。
- **Windows 上 Codex 目录在 WSL 里（`\\wsl.localhost`）时，分叉出来的会话用量一直不导入**。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @allen546（Antigravity Argon 每周额度）、@fisHarly0（SSE 分隔符说明）的贡献。

特别感谢以下贡献者：你们的 PR 发现并修复了真实的问题，只是同样的问题后来在主线上另行修好，PR 因此关闭。@SailingLoong（Codex 故障转移时更换模型，本版的修复参考了这个 PR 的思路）、@xiajiahang（聚合模式拖动排序后重排聚合模型）。

感谢 @erickksun、@Juddd、@EMnian、@shidao-ap5、@LeenixP 报告问题、提供复现信息和修复思路。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

name: v0.2.2
body:
## Highlights

- **Speculative decoding.** `--speculative-algorithm mtp` drafts with the checkpoint's own MTP layer, and `--speculative-algorithm dflash` drafts with a separate DFlash 2 checkpoint (#836, #844, #856, #857).
- **New model.** Ripple-65B Preview, from BF16 safetensors, the ModelOpt NVFP4 export or GGUF (#871).
- **Faster CPU experts in `hybrid`.** The NVFP4 W4A8 CPU kernels are faster; rerun `ft bench bw` so `hybrid` uses the new CPU rate (#851).

## Speculative Decoding

Each decode step drafts k tokens and verifies them on the target in one forward, so one step can commit several tokens. With sampling, the output distribution stays the target's. Speculative decoding is off by default, and the draft stays on the GPU, so it takes some KV and expert cache space. See the [flags](https://github.com/FlashML-org/FreeToken/blob/main/docs/cli.md#speculative-decoding).

| Target | off | MTP (faster of k=3, k=7) | DFlash 2, k=7 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Qwen3.8-27B (BF16) | 50.1 | 144.4 (2.88x) | 215.0 (4.29x) |
| Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (BF16) | 193.1 | 359.6 (1.86x) | 475.7 (2.46x) |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 | 92.9 | 149.7 (1.61x) | 174.2 (1.87x) |

tok/s on an H100, one request, AIME25 problem 1, `temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=20`, median of 5 runs.

- [Feature] `--speculative-algorithm mtp`: the Qwen3.5 family (Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, Qwen3.8-27B) and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, from HF or GGUF. A Flash-Next GGUF needs a Strata MTP pack (#836, #844, #856)
- [Feature] `--speculative-algorithm dflash`: Qwen3.8-27B, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, with a DFlash 2 draft passed through `--speculative-draft-model-path`, such as `incoai/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-DFlash2` (#857)
- Not supported yet: TP above 1, and targets with sliding-window or DSV4 window-tier KV.

## GGUF Support

- [Feature] Serve gpt-oss GGUF checkpoints on `gpt_oss` (#838)
- [Feature] Serve image input on `qwen3vl` GGUFs from a DeepStack `qwen3vl_merger` mmproj (#827)
- [Feature] Serve image input on `muse-glimmer` GGUFs from a `muse-glimmer` mmproj (#830)
- [Feature] Serve image input on `minimax-m3` GGUFs from a `minimax_m3` mmproj (#829)
- [Feature] Add an IQ1_M MMQ kernel (#835)
- [Feature] Read NVFP4 weight scales on `qwen4exp` GGUFs (#845)
- [Perf] Sort MoE MMQ routes with a counting sort (#872, #878)
- [Fix] Skip inactive GGUF routes in hybrid decode (#823)
- [Fix] Log why mmproj auto-discovery skips a file (#860)
- [Docs] Document GGUF support (#867)

## Model Support

- [Feature] Add Ripple-65B Preview support (#871)
- [Fix] Read stop ids from `config.json` without `generation_config.json` (#874)

## Engine

- [Perf] Speed up the CPU MoE NVFP4 W4A8 kernels (#851)
- [Perf] Give only the routes the CPU computes work items in a hybrid step (#866)
- [Fix] Stop the SWA prefill commit from freeing pages the request still reads (#651)
- [Fix] Send graph-capture KV writes to the dummy page (#877)
- [Fix] Add once-per-message logger methods (#858)
- [Docs] Add a [guide to speeding up decode](https://github.com/FlashML-org/FreeToken/blob/main/docs/performance/decode.md) (#859)

## Kernels

- [Fix] Avoid overflow in Triton KV cache offsets (#854)
- [Fix] Size the decode KV tile to the shared-memory budget (#840)

## Server and CLI

- [Feature] Report per-request prefill and decode timings in API responses with `--enable-timings-report` (#814)
- [Feature] Add `continuous_usage_stats` and count shell tok/s from it (#868)
- [Fix] Recover Qwen tool calls after unclosed think (#825)
- [Fix] Refuse `n != 1` on `/v1/completions` instead of ignoring it (#842)
- [Fix] Reject empty completions prompt and keep error code (#850)
- [Fix] Bound top-k before int32 conversion (#790)

## AMD ROCm (WIP, experimental)

- [Fix] Publish ROCm CPU expert inputs before notification (#764)

## Breaking Changes & Deprecations

- **`qwen3vl` / `qwen3vlmoe`, `muse-glimmer` and `minimax-m3` GGUF models with a fitting `*mmproj*.gguf` in their folder now build the vision tower.** `--text-model-only` keeps them text-only (#827, #829, #830).
- **`/v1/completions` with `n != 1` now returns 400** instead of one choice (#842).

## Contributors

@jason-fxz, @ischencheng, @void-mckenzie, @LZ-QWQ, @madbrain76, @festeraeb, @A5bhinav, @zihaomu, @wenlive, @techsaurabh-394

First contributions this release:

- @madbrain76 in #825
- @festeraeb in #840
- @A5bhinav in #842
- @wenlive in #790
- @techsaurabh-394 in #850

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/FlashML-org/FreeToken/compare/v0.2.1...v0.2.2

name: v0.5.4
body:
## 中文

### 主要更新

- **MCP 与实时上下文**：注册 Streamable HTTP MCP Server，检索、调用工具，并把工具挂载为可读取的 Markdown 节点。提供 REST、CLI 和 SDK 入口；同步上游工具后可查看受影响的挂载。[#6263](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6263)
- **Agent 规则查询**：多种 Agent 集成增加 Rule Search 入口，在执行操作前按需查找适用规则。升级插件或重连 MCP 客户端后生效；这不会自动增加每轮拦截。[#7005](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7005)
- **Watch 多节点运行**：增加 MySQL Watch 存储和列表分页；Connector 授权撤销后自动暂停，重新授权时只恢复此前自动暂停的任务。[#6756](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6756)、[#6944](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6944)
- **会话恢复与记忆整理**：失败或失去执行任务的归档支持带内容哈希的显式重试；可用 `ov compile memory` 整理当前用户的已有记忆。[#5802](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/5802)、[#6829](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6829)
- **配置与访问控制**：Account 可独立配置抽取开关、生成语言及解析凭证；普通用户可管理自己的添加位置和记忆策略。新增由 ROOT 管理的 GLOBAL 身份及按数据所有者配置的读取策略。[#6986](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6986)、[#7050](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7050)、[#6900](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6900)、[#6932](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6932)

### 可选可观测性上报

新增可选 Kafka 事件与存量盘点上报，需要安装 `openviking[reporting]` 并显式开启，默认关闭。上报保留部署、数据空间、用户和模型费用归属，不包含原文、提示词或 API Key；采用内存队列，允许丢失，不适合作为持久化审计或计费账本。[#7143](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7143)

### 发布版本

主包 `openviking==0.5.4`、Python SDK `openviking-sdk==0.1.19`、独立 CLI `0.5.2`。已有 Python SDK 和独立 CLI 用户需要升级相应组件，才能获得本版的组成员接口适配。

```bash
pip install --upgrade 'openviking==0.5.4' 'openviking-sdk==0.1.19'
```

### 使用示例

以下示例要求已配置对应版本的 `ov` 和用户凭证。天气 MCP 的地址、工具名及参数需替换为实际服务。

```bash
ov mcps add -p viking://agent/tools --wait '{"mcpServers":{"weather":{"url":"https://mcp.example.com/mcp"}}}'
ov mcps find "查询北京当前天气" --limit 5
ov mcps mount viking://agent/tools/weather/current.json viking://resources/live/weather-beijing.md --title "北京实时天气" --args '{"city":"Beijing"}' --wait
ov read viking://resources/live/weather-beijing.md

ov compile memory --instruction "整理已有记忆，保留不同对象的独立事实"
```

读取实时节点只会透明调用符合只读要求的工具。显式声明为非只读或破坏性的工具，需要通过 `ov mcps invoke` 调用。

### 升级与迁移

1. **共享存储部署不能新旧混跑**：锁租约协议发生变化。先停止所有锁参与者（包括队列 worker），再统一部署新版本。SQLite 自动增加 `holders` 列；不要丢弃已有队列 handoff。
2. **组成员移除 HTTP 接口变更**：从 `DELETE .../members/{user_id}` 改为 `DELETE .../members`，请求体为 `{"user_ids":["alice","bob"]}`。本版 CLI、Python/Go SDK 已适配批量端点，原有单用户方法仍可调用；直接使用旧 HTTP 路径的调用方需要迁移。
3. **单文件恢复参数变更**：`POST /api/v1/snapshot/restore` 的单文件模式改用 `restore_commit_id`、`current_commit_id`，两者均为完整 40 位 commit ID；不能继续传原有版本 UUID。目录恢复仍使用原有入口。
4. **Python/Go SDK 移除旧配置方法**：Agent Evolution 和旧 Account settings 方法已删除，调用方应迁移至 Account configuration HTTP 接口。服务端旧 HTTP 适配器本版本仍保留并标记弃用。
5. **CacheFS 配置收敛**：删除 `max_file_size_bytes`、`traversal_mode`、`bypass_prefixes`。缓存改为文件系统查询结果缓存。Redis 默认连接超时改为 10 秒、命令超时为 0（不设超时）、缓存 TTL 为 300 秒；依赖原默认值的部署应显式配置。
6. **Noul rerank 默认变化**：默认隔离候选；需要旧的共享候选行为时显式设置 `candidates_visible=true`。Choice 模式不受此开关影响。

MySQL Watch 是可选能力：启用前安装 MySQL 依赖、执行建表脚本，并为所有节点配置相同的凭证加密密钥。默认 file Watch 仍只适用于单进程。

### 修复

- **恢复跨目录并发**：创建新的 Watch、目录和目录迁移时只锁定实际目标范围，不再因兄弟目录正在处理而扩大到公共父目录；删除多级不存在路径时不额外创建空目录。[#7265](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7265)
- **文件写入与目录刷新分离**：写入仍等待文件自身摘要和向量完成，直接父目录的 L0/L1 与目录向量独立刷新；慢目录处理不再延长正文锁等待。[#7268](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7268)
- **保持组成员客户端方法可用**：CLI、Python 和 Go SDK 的单成员添加/移除方法使用批量端点和单元素请求体。[#7258](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7258)
- 修复训练、记忆替换后的 case/experience 链接维护，以及 LangChain Store 生命周期、持久化和 Unicode 归档查询。[#6898](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6898)、[#7038](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7038)、[#7039](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7039)、[#7040](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7040)

- 保留旧添加位置配置兼容：`viking://user/resources`、`viking://user/skills` 在加载时转换为当前用户家目录 URI，避免沿用旧 `ov.conf` 升级后无法启动。[#7140](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7140)
- Go SDK 的 `AddSkill`、`UpdateSkill` 可接收较长的内联 Markdown，不再因本地文件名长度限制而提前失败。[#7103](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7103)
- 飞书表格单元格、嵌入白板，以及带空 ATX 标题或 CRLF frontmatter 的 Markdown 内容解析。[#7083](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7083)、[#7075](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7075)、[#7117](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7117)、[#6819](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6819)
- 关闭去重的 recall 不再创建会话；eager prefetch 尊重大于 5 的 `prefetch_search_topn`，并正确序列化时间元数据。[#7064](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7064)、[#6925](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6925)、[#6977](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6977)
- 改善记忆抽取修复截断时的有效操作保留、记忆拆分后的链接维护，以及会话压缩的历史大小控制。[#7052](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7052)、[#5922](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/5922)、[#6771](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6771)
- 改善上游流式错误传递、断连后的工具流清理、任务取消及跨节点锁续租行为。[#6995](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6995)、[#6892](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6892)、[#7082](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7082)、[#6718](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6718)

### 首次贡献者

感谢本版本的 11 位首次贡献者：名单见下方中英文共用的贡献者列表。

## English

### Highlights

- **MCP and live context**: Register Streamable HTTP MCP servers, discover and invoke tools, and mount tools as readable Markdown nodes through REST, CLI and SDK interfaces. Sync reports affected mounts. [#6263](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6263)
- **Rule discovery across agent integrations**: Query applicable rules before taking an action. Update the plugin or reconnect the MCP client to discover the new tool; this does not add an automatic per-turn enforcement hook. [#7005](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7005)
- **Distributed Watches**: Optional MySQL storage, paginated listing, and connector credential lifecycle handling. Reauthorization resumes only Watches paused automatically by credential revocation. [#6756](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6756), [#6944](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6944)
- **Archive recovery and memory consolidation**: Explicit, hash-bound retry for failed or ownerless archives; use `ov compile memory` to consolidate existing memories for the current user. [#5802](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/5802), [#6829](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6829)
- **Scoped configuration and access control**: Account-level extraction, language and parser credentials, user-managed settings, and ROOT-managed GLOBAL identities with data-owner access policies. [#6986](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6986), [#7050](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7050), [#6900](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6900), [#6932](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6932)

The CLI examples above show registration, discovery, mounting and reading of a live node, followed by memory consolidation. Replace the example MCP server and tool schema with your actual service. Only tools meeting the read-only requirements execute transparently during reads; invoke non-read-only or destructive tools explicitly.

### Published versions

Main package `openviking==0.5.4`, Python SDK `openviking-sdk==0.1.19`, and standalone CLI `0.5.2`. Upgrade the corresponding client package or binary to receive the group-membership adaptation.

### Optional observability reporting

Optional Kafka events and inventory export require `openviking[reporting]` and explicit enablement. Reporting preserves deployment, workspace, user and model-cost ownership without source text, prompts or API keys. Its in-memory queue allows loss and is not a durable audit or billing ledger. [#7143](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7143)

### Upgrade and migration

1. **Do not mix old and new lock participants on shared storage.** Stop all participants, including queue workers, before deploying the new lease protocol. SQLite adds the `holders` column automatically; retain persisted queue handoffs.
2. **Group member removal uses a batch body.** Replace `DELETE .../members/{user_id}` with `DELETE .../members` and `{"user_ids":["alice","bob"]}`. The CLI and Python/Go SDK now adapt existing single-user methods to the collection route; direct callers of the old HTTP path must migrate.
3. **Single-file restore uses commit IDs.** Supply `restore_commit_id` and `current_commit_id`, both full 40-character commit IDs, instead of version UUIDs. The directory restore interface is unchanged.
4. **Legacy configuration methods are removed from the Python and Go SDKs.** Migrate Agent Evolution and old Account settings calls to the Account configuration HTTP API. Deprecated server-side HTTP adapters remain in this release.
5. **CacheFS now caches query results.** Remove `max_file_size_bytes`, `traversal_mode` and `bypass_prefixes`. Redis defaults become a 10-second connection timeout, no command timeout, and a 300-second cache TTL; configure explicit values when needed.
6. **Noul reranking isolates candidates by default.** Set `candidates_visible=true` to retain shared candidate visibility. Choice mode is unaffected by this option.

MySQL Watch storage requires the MySQL dependency, schema initialization and the same credential encryption key on every participating node. File-backed Watches remain single-process.

### Fixes

- Restore sibling-path concurrency for Watch creation, directory creation and transfers by locking the actual target scope. Idempotent removal of deeply missing paths does not create empty parents. [#7265](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7265)
- Separate file processing from direct-parent L0/L1 and directory-vector refresh. File writes still wait for their own summaries and vectors; slow directory refresh no longer extends the content-lock wait. [#7268](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7268)
- Keep existing single-member CLI, Python and Go methods working through collection membership routes and singleton request bodies. [#7258](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7258)
- Preserve case/experience links during training and memory replacement; correct LangChain Store ownership, persistence and Unicode archive queries. [#6898](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6898), [#7038](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7038), [#7039](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7039), [#7040](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7040)

- Preserve legacy add-target configuration by translating `viking://user/resources` and `viking://user/skills` to current-user home URIs during configuration loading, preventing startup failures with existing `ov.conf` files. [#7140](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7140)
- Accept long inline Markdown in Go SDK `AddSkill` and `UpdateSkill` without failing on local filename-length limits. [#7103](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7103)
This release improves Feishu table and whiteboard parsing, Markdown parsing, sessionless recall, eager-prefetch limits and datetime serialization, memory-operation recovery and link maintenance, session compression, upstream stream errors, cancellation and distributed lock renewal. See the linked PRs in the Chinese section for the exact changes.

### First-time contributors

Thank you to the 11 first-time contributors below. GitHub generated this list for the locked release range; each PR is present in that range.

name: v15.13.0
body:
## Critical fix

- **Cursor summaries:** Cursor sessions got no summary on native Windows, or when the workspace path had a `_`, a space or a dot folder in it. claude-mem now looks for the transcript in the project folder Cursor actually names, so those sessions get summaries again (#5544, thanks @tanishqbaweja; the same symptom was first reported in #2248 by @wbingli).

## New

- **Auto-clear at 33% context (off by default):** turn it on with `CLAUDE_MEM_AUTO_CLEAR_ENABLED=true`. When a Claude Code conversation reaches a third of the context window, Claude saves its work state, claude-mem runs `/clear` and sends `continue`, and the fresh conversation picks the work back up. No save means no clear (#5486).
- **Standard Compute preset** for the openai-compatible provider (#5492, thanks @henrikdukefoss).
- **PopNow preset** for the openai-compatible provider (#5434, thanks @kyuminjo).

## Fixes

- **Chroma:** deleting many observations at once no longer piles up cleanups that lock chroma-mcp for hours; they now run one at a time (#5496, thanks @xunguangzlj-cloud; reported in #5495 by @voyvodka).
- **CLI:** `claude-mem --help`, `-h` and a mistyped command print usage instead of starting a foreground worker (#5491, thanks @ryrenz; reported in #5490 by @ukdataservices-admin).
- **CLI:** `--flag=value` works in `server api-key`, `memory ingest` and `adopt`, so `--scope=memories:read` really makes a read-only key (#5469, thanks @rudycelekli).
- **Doctor:** `npx claude-mem doctor` no longer crashes at exit on Windows (#5465, thanks @tng7576650-commits).
- **CMEM Pro sign-in:** when cmem.ai refuses a sign-in start without a message, the installer shows the HTTP status instead of connectivity advice (#5498, thanks @xunguangzlj-cloud).
- **Redaction:** vendor keys printed at the start of a line in tool output are now redacted (#5521).
- **Cowork:** the Cowork shim redacts the NVIDIA, Runcrate, Groq, xAI and Perplexity keys the worker already redacts (#5483, thanks @DeryFerd).
- **Windsurf:** the installer writes `hooks.json` and the rules file atomically, so an interrupted install can't leave Windsurf with a broken hooks file (#5542, thanks @DeryFerd).
- **Server:** the viewer feed endpoints bound the `offset` a client can send (#5485, thanks @DeryFerd).
- **Install:** OpenCode, Kimi and Antigravity config files saved with a UTF-8 BOM are read correctly (#5472, thanks @rudycelekli).
- **Launcher:** a `~` at the start of `CLAUDE_MEM_DATA_DIR` is expanded when recording an empty hook payload, instead of creating a `~` folder in the project (#5473, thanks @rudycelekli).
- **Import:** re-importing an export keeps project merges (`merged_into_project`) (#5471, thanks @rudycelekli).
- **DSH:** ingested tool memories keep the configured `platformSource` (#5470, thanks @rudycelekli).
- **CLAUDE.md:** in a monorepo, folder CLAUDE.md rows are headed with a file that is in that folder (#5468, thanks @rudycelekli).
- **My Work:** commits made with `git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF' ...)"` and every `gh pr` title form are read correctly (#5480, thanks @rudycelekli).
- **Search:** file filters match whether paths use `/` or `\` (#5466, thanks @liuyinchu).
- **Hermes:** malformed endpoints and truncated responses fall back cleanly, sessions end even when the final event fails, and recall on long prompts stops at the query limit (#5462, thanks @Afloat16).

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/compare/v15.12.1...v15.13.0

name: v15.12.1
body:
## Two critical fixes

- **macOS 12 (system SQLite 3.37):** observations failed to save with "SQL logic error" on every write. Statements that use `RETURNING` are now read with `.all()`, so observations store again (#5499, thanks @xunguangzlj-cloud; reported in #5497 by @hamadikante0-ship-it).
- **CMEM Pro sign-in:** since 15.11.0, sign-in stopped at its first step with "Could not start OAuth login". The installer now accepts the setup id that cmem.ai echoes into its sign-in links (#5502; reported in #5493 by @luciano-fiandesio).

## Other fixes

- **Cursor:** the installer writes `hooks.json` atomically, so an interrupted install or uninstall can no longer leave Cursor with a broken hooks file (#5484, thanks @DeryFerd).
- **Worker security:** the operator processing route rejects requests from foreign localhost origins (#5482, thanks @DeryFerd).
- **Timeline:** a `#123` anchor is read as an observation id, not a date (#5479, thanks @rudycelekli).
- **Prompt import:** Claude Code transcripts and settings are read from `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` when it is set (#5476, thanks @rudycelekli).
- **Server:** truncating event payloads in the generation prompt keeps emoji and other surrogate pairs whole (#5478, thanks @rudycelekli).
- **Server:** the legacy `SERVER_BETA` key is rotated when the canonical key is blank (#5477, thanks @rudycelekli).
- **OpenClaw:** `/claude-mem-search 4019` searches for the number instead of reading it as a result limit (#5474, thanks @rudycelekli).
- **OpenClaw:** worker session posts are stamped with platform source `openclaw` (#5475, thanks @rudycelekli).

## Also in this release

- **CI:** superseded runs are cancelled, and the 5-OS image matrix runs only for image changes (#5481).
- **Tests:** orphan-process snapshots skip unrelated system processes on Windows (#5501, thanks @liuyinchu).

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/compare/v15.12.0...v15.12.1

body:
Automated release candidate build from `main`.\n\n**npm:** `npm install gitnexus@rc`\n**Version:** `1.6.13-rc.216`\n**Target base:** `1.6.13` (rc #216)\n**Source commit (main):** 18b28f1261ad7bc91282ce4fa7c5004296503bb5\n**Release commit (versioned tree):** da68dd19e8eb7a70c32d6d221f01f9ca8f927a6c\n\nRelease candidates are pre-stable builds intended for early testing. Stable releases remain on the `latest` dist-tag.

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v1.6.13-rc.216 -->

## What's Changed
### 🚨 Security
* Improve MCP startup compatibility and lazy-load CLI commands by @Shockang in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/207
* test: add integration test coverage and fix KuzuDB fork crashes by @magyargergo in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/209
### 🚀 Features
* feat(hooks): auto-reindex after git commit with embeddings preservation by @L1nusB in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/205
* feat: HTTP embedding backend for self-hosted/remote endpoints by @zm2231 in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/395
* feat: complete Swift support — query fix, export detection, implicit imports, constructor resolution by @marxo126 in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/408
* feat(cli): add 'index' command to register existing .gitnexus/ folder by @adonisdoda in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/402
* feat: add docker support by @BRAINIFII in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/848
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
* fix: add preinstall cleanup to prevent ENOTEMPTY on global upgrade by @magyargergo with @Copilot in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/843
* fix: set env.cacheDir to user-writable location by @enihcam in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/845
* fix: devendor tree-sitter-proto install lifecycle to prevent ENOTEMPTY on global upgrade by @magyargergo in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/846
* fix: shard parse cache persistence on large repos by @BlackOvOoo in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/1580
* fix(rust): respect Cargo target boundaries in name fallback by @Sweetdevil144 in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/3294
### 🏎️ Performance
* perf(go): kill O(n²) scope-capture re-walks (resolves #1848 quarantine) by @magyargergo in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/1915
### 👷 CI/CD
* ci: add macOS to cross-platform test matrix by @magyargergo in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/208

name: v2.1.7
body:
### Fixes
- fix: #1338 source test follows the D1 helper (d1UpdateCommand)
- fix: doctor D1 in an unsupported host shows the host line, not the Gemini update command (#1340)
- fix: the #1338 ctx_upgrade test follows the platform: no CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR words on Windows by design
- fix: CLI doctor names an unsupported host only when no supported agent is found; the background-hold note says the process was stopped (review of 2.1.6..c8180a97)
- fix: doctor D1 names the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR profile like ctx_upgrade; Pi and OpenCode are never marked unsupported by a terminal env var (review of 2.1.6..7bb515e8)
- fix: doctor D1 update is WARN with the agent's own command, D3 reads every OpenCode config and tuple entries, D6 PASS for in-process plugins (#1339)
- fix: setup renews a stale Claude Code plugin copy with the host's own update and ends in a WARN instead of a rollback; custom CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR profiles are named in doctor and ctx_upgrade (#1338)
- fix: unsupported-host lines live in one module; Pi and Pi-Bolt never unsupported (test)
- fix: doctor and setup say clearly when a host is not supported
- fix: ctx_execute settles on exit plus a bounded pipe drain; killTree never blocks the host loop (#1337)
- fix: policy.json routes.webfetch off and allowHosts turn off the WebFetch route (#1336)
- fix: doctor D3 names Antigravity once instead of wrong Gemini entries (#1340)

### Who gets this

One version on both channels: the release commit on main (GitHub) and npm.

| Agent | Channel | Update with |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | GitHub | `claude plugin update context-mode@context-mode` |
| Codex | GitHub, npm for the one-time hook trust step | `codex plugin marketplace upgrade context-mode` |
| Gemini CLI | GitHub | `gemini extensions update context-mode` |
| Qwen Code | GitHub | `qwen extensions update context-mode` |
| Copilot CLI | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| VS Code (Copilot) | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| Kiro | npm | `context-mode upgrade` |
| ZCode | GitHub | `zcode plugins update context-mode@context-mode` |
| Pi | npm | `pi update --extensions` |
| OpenCode | npm | `opencode plugin update` |

Automated immutable nightly built from an exact `main` commit. Nightlies are
opt-in, may be less stable than regular releases, and never replace stable
update discovery.

# Cua Driver 0.45.2

## Summary

This release includes 3 fixes.

## Fixes

- wait for a foreground-activated macOS control to report enabled. ([#7041](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/7041))
- spawn owned-discovery fixture with only its named listeners. ([#7048](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/7048))
- report the KWin capture switch and desktop entry as KWin reads them. ([#7042](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/7042)) Thanks @astrovm.

## Contributors

Thanks to @astrovm for contributing to this release.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
```

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds,
and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and
uninstaller scripts.

## Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest”
pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua
Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on
their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned
`cua-driver-rs-v*` releases directly.
